newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers bump up share offering.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers bump up share offering.

text.p: Shareholders will sell even more shares in an offering by Florida Panthers Holdings Inc, the sports and entertainment company owned by Wayne Huizenga.

According to documents filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, a total of 6,780,135 Class A shares will be sold, up from the first plan to offer 6,339,836 shares. Six million of the shares will be sold by the Panthers.
The deal is scheduled to price tonight for trading Wednesday, according to lead underwriter Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette.
Shares were down 11/16 to 19-1/2 and at one point hit 19-3/16, a new low since their move to the New York Stock Exchange. The shares were formerly traded on the Nasdaq under the symbol "PUCK".
The company went public last fall for $10 a share.
